lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Legion holds the gate. The west wall and the east wall are broken through.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The man in the keep is not with them. {mc} can talk to him from a tile beside him.

lines.speaker: mc
lines.text: If he's hunted too, he might listen.

lines.speaker: blade
lines.text: Or he might take your head. Either way, I will meet him.
